title: 1RB0RE_1RC1RE_1LD1LC_0RB0LC_1RF0RB_---1RA: the bit model is proved in Lean
text: For 1RB0RE_1RC1RE_1LD1LC_0RB0LC_1RF0RB_---1RA, Lean now proves that one round trip between left-end turns is one pass of a 4-state automaton over the tape's bit word, for every word, and that the machine halts from blank tape if and only if the orbit of the word 001 under that map stops (lean/BitModel.lean, kernel only). The machine stays open: nothing is proved about the orbit.
